'''Watercrest Outpost''', formally a resort called '''Cliffview''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Reyniu]]. The trade died off during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] later turned it into a secret [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] base. The staff allowed limited outsiders into the resort as part of the charade, but discouraged repeat visits.<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Watercrest Outpost was listed as an example of a Rebel base in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
